title: Countable family uniformly approximating C_c(X) with support control (X locally compact, Hausdorff, second countable)
statement: Let X be a locally compact Hausdorff topological space with a countable basis. Then there is a sequence (g_k)_{k∈ℕ} of continuous compactly supported functions g_k : X → ℝ such that for every continuous compactly supported f : X → ℝ there is a compact set K ⊆ X with tsupport f ⊆ K such that for every η > 0 there is k ∈ ℕ with tsupport g_k ⊆ K and |f(x) − g_k(x)| ≤ η for all x ∈ X.
lean_statement: ∀ (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X], ∃ g : ℕ → C_c(X, ℝ), ∀ f : C_c(X, ℝ), ∃ K : Set X, IsCompact K ∧ tsupport f ⊆ K ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ k : ℕ, tsupport (g k) ⊆ K ∧ ∀ x : X, |f x - g k x| ≤ η
